name: Scroll Shock Trap

stealth.note: (expert) or @Check[perception|dc:29|traits:action:seek] (expert) to spot the control panel

description: Five scroll symbols shoot electricity bolts around the room.
disable:
DC 25 Thievery (expert) or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24)

DC 29 Thievery (master) to disable the entire trap from the hidden control panel beneath the central slab.
reset: The trap deactivates 1 round after it has no target creatures and resets after 1 minute.
routine:
(5 actions) Each disabled symbol reduces the trap's number of actions by 1.

For each of its actions, a different symbol shoots an electricity bolt at a random creature in the room. The trap doesn't take multiple attack penalties.

generalAbilities.name: Symbol Stats (Each)
generalAbilities.description:
Hardness 16

HP 64 (BT 32)

Resistances Electricity 15

Immunities Critical Hits, Object Immunities, Precision Damage

generalAbilities.name: Control Panel Stats
generalAbilities.description:
Hardness 18

HP 72 (BT 36)

Resistances Electricity 15

Immunities Critical Hits, Object Immunities, Precision Damage

generalAbilities.name: Reactive Charge
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature without an Aspis Consortium badge approaches within 5 feet of a slab

Effect Both double doors leading out of the room shut and lock. While the trap is active, the doors must be battered open (Hardness 18; Panel HP 72 [BT 36]; DC 29 Athletics to Force Open). The closest symbol to the triggering creature shoots an electricity bolt attack at it. The trap then rolls initiative.
